def pay_loop(km, rain):
    out = np.empty(len(km))
    for i in range(len(km)):
        p = 60 + 14 * km[i]
        if km[i] > 8:
            p += 100
        if rain[i]:
            p *= 1.3
        out[i] = p
    return out

def pay_vec(km, rain):

import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(2)
orders = rng.uniform(0, 20, size=(30_000, 2))
shops = np.array([[3, 4], [15, 5], [10, 12], [4, 16], [17, 17], [9, 2]], dtype=float)

def nearest_loop(orders, shops):
    res = np.empty(len(orders), dtype=int)
    for i in range(len(orders)):
        best, best_d = -1, np.inf
        for j in range(len(shops)):
            d = abs(orders[i, 0] - shops[j, 0]) + abs(orders[i, 1] - shops[j, 1])
            if d < best_d:
                best, best_d = j, d
        res[i] = best
    return res

def nearest_vec(orders, shops):
    dist=np.column_stack([np.abs(orders-shop).sum(axis=1) for shop in shops])
    return dist.argmin(axis=1)

t=time.perf_counter()
ref=nearest_loop(orders,shops)
t_loop=time.perf_counter()-t
t=time.perf_counter()
ans=nearest_vec(orders,shops)
t_vec=time.perf_counter()-t
speedup=t_loop/t_vec
assert np.array_equal(ref,ans)

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["walk"] = (ok["courier"] == "пеший").astype(int)

class MyLinearRegression(RegressorMixin, BaseEstimator):
    def fit(self, X, y):
        X = np.asarray(X, dtype=float)
        X1 = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X)), X])
        w = np.linalg.solve(X1.T @ X1, X1.T @ np.asarray(y, dtype=float))
        self.intercept_, self.coef_ = w[0], w[1:]
        return self

    def predict(self, X):
        return np.asarray(X, dtype=float) @ self.coef_ + self.intercept_

def cv(m,X,y):

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

f = pd.read_csv("family_members.csv")
X = f[["gender", "age", "income_k", "family_size"]].values
y = f["spend_k"].values
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
P = np.random.default_rng(42).normal(size=(4, 4))

rows=[]
for depth in [3,5,8]:
    tree=DecisionTreeRegressor(max_depth=depth,random_state=0)
    rows.append([tree.fit(X_train,y_train).score(X_test,y_test),tree.fit(X_train@P,y_train).score(X_test@P,y_test)])
trees=pd.DataFrame(rows,index=[3,5,8],columns=["open","hidden"]).round(4)
best_open=trees["open"].max()
best_hidden=trees["hidden"].max()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
f = pd.read_csv("family_members.csv")
X = f[["gender", "age", "income_k", "family_size"]].values.astype(float)
P = np.random.default_rng(42).normal(size=(4, 4))
hidden = X @ P

known=X[:4]
P_found=np.linalg.solve(known,hidden[:4])
key_found=np.allclose(P_found,P)
restored=hidden@np.linalg.inv(P_found)
leaked=(abs(restored-X)<.01).all(axis=1).mean()
